resources.string: Nothing new is turned on. You switch on each feature yourself in Features.
Turns on every feature and walks you through each Android permission in one pass.
You can change this any time on the agent\'s page, or turn everything off with Max control on Home or in Settings.

This turns on every feature switch (%2$s) and lets %1$s use all of them, including features added in later updates.

Next, Android asks you for each permission and special access on its own screens. Skip any you don't want.

Everything stays revocable: Pause on Home stops every agent, and Max control on Home or in Settings turns everything off.

This turns on every feature switch (%1$s) for the agents you allow.

Next, Android asks you for each permission and special access on its own screens. Skip any you don't want.

Everything stays revocable: Pause on Home stops every agent, and Max control on Home or in Settings turns everything off.
Every feature switch goes off, so agents can only check status until you turn features back on. Android permissions stay granted; Access lists each one if you want to remove it.
Every feature switch is on. Now Android needs your OK for each permission below. Tap Continue to go through them in order; skip any you don\'t want.
Every feature switch is on and %1$s may use all of them. Now Android needs your OK for each permission below. Tap Continue to go through them in order; skip any you don\'t want.
Every feature switch is on. Android now asks for each permission on its own screens, one after another; Bridgit moves on by itself. Skip one and it stops here, so you can pick up later.

Every feature switch is on and %1$s may use all of them. Android now asks for each permission on its own screens, one after another; Bridgit moves on by itself. Skip one and it stops here, so you can pick up later.
Skipped: %1$s. You can turn these on later in More > Access.
All %1$d features are on and ready.
%1$d of %2$d features are on and ready. Still need setup: %3$s.
Android won\'t ask again. Turn it on in App info > Permissions.
Lets agents ask where the phone is.
Lets agents read the step counter and motion sensors.
Lets agents read steps, sleep and heart rate you allow.
Lets agents see which apps you used and when.
Lets agents change brightness and other phone settings for a while.
Lets agents ring the phone and change sound modes.
Lets Bridgit install its own updates after you confirm.
Lets agents see the screen and use the features of this service.
Lets agents read the notifications on this phone.
Android blocks accessibility and notification access for apps installed from a file. In App info, tap ⋮ then Allow restricted settings, then come back and try again.
Another permission a Bridgit feature uses.
Turns on every feature and goes straight to Android\'s own prompts
